sentences.en: Many plants in the Americas are only pollinated by hummingbirds.
sentences.zh: 美洲许多植物只能靠蜂鸟授粉。

sentences.en: In this area, seventy percent of the plants are pollinated by bees.
sentences.zh: 在这个地区，百分之七十的植物都是蜜蜂授粉。

sentences.en: Fig tree are pollinated by insects.
sentences.zh: 无花果是由昆虫授粉的。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：pollin（看作pollen，花粉） + ate→给…授粉
